messages.subject: Web Based AI-App
parts:

What I am trying: reactiveText() although it doesn't work.

Second issue: Shiny puts the results of the AI in my RStudio output
What I want it to do: Provide the answers in the web-browser
What I am trying: I have no idea why this stopped working it was working before I asked it to call AI_CONCIERGE_2()

Third issue: Haven't encountered yet
What I want it to do: sit out on the web so I can demonstrate it to my class during a presentation. This means it needs to run without its data sets and without the demo computer having R, RStudio, etc.
What I am trying: Not here yet, although I did make an account with Shiny to eventually host it.
